notes:
Account snapshot: Stonewell builds AI risk and claims automation for mid-large insurers. Evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) to replace an on-prem inference cluster. Primary drivers: strict data residency, full audit trails, and customer-specific KMS/HSM integration.

Recent timeline:
- 2026-01-14: Intro call (AE Eleanor) — high level requirements captured; asked for architecture options (VPC vs on-prem).
- 2026-02-18: Security deep-dive (SE Daniel + Stonewell SecOps) — discussed network topology, private control plane, and cert management. (ff_2026-02-18_stonewell_security_review).
- 2026-03-03: Demo + latency walkthrough (Prod demo) — ran sample chat + embed pipeline on dedicated config; observed 40–80ms tail P50 for small models, P95 spikes during long-runner workloads. (ff_2026-03-03_prod-demo-call).
- 2026-03-09: Legal provided baseline SOC2/ISO questions; asked for CMEK and key rotation cadence.
- 2026-03-10: Internal Redwood pricing & SOW draft shared; procurement kickoff next week.

Encryption posture & technical asks (customer-stated):
- In-transit: require mutual TLS (mTLS) for all control-plane and data-plane connections. Customer will terminate TLS at their VPC edge; expect Redwood Private to support mTLS using customer-supplied certs. Need cert rotation path (auto + manual) and alpha of cert lifetime policy.
- Service-to-service: prefer mTLS between inference pods and KV cache / datastore; request plaintext never leaves host.
- At-rest: All model weights, KV caches, and logs must be encrypted with customer-managed keys (CMEK). They prefer AWS KMS + CloudHSM-backed keys for FIPS-level attestation.
- Key rotation: Must support scheduled key rotation without downtime for tokenized secrets. Prefer zero-downtime rewrap flow; provide recommended rotation frequency (quarterly) and emergency rotation SOP.
- Secrets management: Integrate with HashiCorp Vault (dynamic secrets) or cloud KMS secret stores; they want proof-of-concept for Vault auto-unseal + Redwood secret fetch.
- Audit logging: Full immutable audit logs for crypto operations, admin actions, and request-level tracebacks (token-level redaction). Logs to be exported to customer SIEM (S3/GCP bucket) with retention policy configurable per environment.
- Data residency/segmentation: Data plane must be deployed in their dedicated VPC in us-east-1; control plane optional in customer-managed region. They require encryption-in-transit to never traverse public internet unencrypted and prefer private peering / Transit Gateway.

POC scope agreed:
- 4-week POC: deploy Private VPC in us-east-1 with a production model variant, configure CMEK via AWS KMS, enable mTLS between customer LB and Redwood ingress, and ship audit logs to their S3 bucket.
- Acceptance criteria: successful canary throughput at target latency (P50 < 100ms for chat tokens), no plaintext secrets in logs, evidence of key rotation and audit records.

Open questions / asks from Stonewell:
- Confirm support for CloudHSM-backed KMS keys and provide architecture note for HSM attestation.
- Provide detailed cert rotation steps and automation scripts (they want Terraform + Vault example).
- Clarify where model checkpoints are encrypted and lifecycle for snapshot backups.
- SLA for key-material retrieval and failover if Redwood control plane is unavailable.

Next immediate actions (Redwood):
- SE Daniel to produce an encryption-playbook (draft by 2026-03-17) covering mTLS, CMEK, rotation SOP, Vault integration snippets.
- AE Eleanor to join procurement meeting and circulate SOW + pricing appendix 2026-03-12.
- Security engs to validate audit log exports to Stonewell SIEM format (parquet + gzip) and confirm retention controls.
